The Petitioner has served a copy of the Petition on the Respondents and notice regarding the filing of this Petition has been published in the newspapers in accordance with Section 64 of the Electricity Act, 2003 (hereinafter referred to as “the Act”). No comments or suggestions have been received from the general public in response to the aforesaid notices published in the newspapers by the Petitioner. 6. The final hearing in this matter was held on 30.9.2025 and the order was reserved. 7. This order is passed after considering the submissions made by the Petitioner vide affidavits dated 12.9.2024.
